clue.text: Explain vote

definitions.meaning: to get an idea over to an audience is to make it understood
a voter marks a ballot paper with an X, so voting is literally placing that mark

explanation.definitionFit: To communicate an idea successfully is to explain it; marking a ballot with an X is voting.

clue.text: Persuade to join reporters and go north of the border

parts.note: the press is journalists collectively
in Scots, spoken north of the English border, 'gang' means go

explanation.surface: Someone is coaxed into signing up with journalists and heading to Scotland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'north of the border' means in Scotland, where 'gang' is a dialect word for go.
explanation.definitionFit: Historically sailors were forced into service; now the verb means coercing someone into joining.

clue.text: It grows underground, right?

parts.note: the Tube is the London Underground railway

explanation.surface: Someone checks that a plant develops below the soil.
explanation.walkthrough: 'underground' is also London's railway system, the Tube.
explanation.definitionFit: A potato is a swollen root store, a plant part that develops below the soil.

clue.text: Shield for vehicle put on quickly

indicators.note: in a down clue, put on means set above, so the vehicle word comes first

parts.note: a car is a vehicle
apace means quickly

explanation.surface: Protective armour for a car is fitted in a hurry.
explanation.definitionFit: A tortoise or crab's hard upper shell acts as a protective shield.

clue.text: Serve in remote organization that shows a measure of progress

definitions.text: that shows a measure of progress

indicators.note: in signals the serve word goes inside the rearranged letters
organization suggests the letters are arranged anew

parts.note: to do is to serve, as in 'that will do'

explanation.surface: Working in a distant organisation shows how one's career is advancing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Serve' as DO is the sense 'that will do'; the definition is a thing, so 'that shows' is part of it.
explanation.definitionFit: A mileage counter in a car shows how far the vehicle has travelled.

clue.text: Italian men holding up notice

indicators.note: in a down clue, holding up means placed on top of the next piece

parts.note: a sign is a notice
OR, other ranks, means soldiers who are not officers

explanation.surface: Italian men are carrying a placard.
explanation.walkthrough: OR stands for other ranks, the ordinary soldiers, so 'men' in crosswords often gives it.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the Italian title for a gentleman, equivalent to Mr, so an Italian man.

clue.text: Aide and colleague of religious leader

parts.note: PA, a personal assistant, is an aide
a pal is a friend or mate, here a colleague

explanation.surface: Someone describes the helper and workmate of a churchman.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective describes anything belonging to the Pope, the head of the Catholic Church.

clue.text: Picture nitrogen as a tiny particle

parts.note: a photo is a picture
N is the chemical symbol for nitrogen

explanation.surface: A scientist imagines nitrogen as a minute particle.
explanation.definitionFit: A quantum of light is an elementary particle, tinier than an atom.

clue.text: Some artists are so original

definitions.meaning: untrained or naive painters, as a school of artists
first or earliest, belonging to an early stage

explanation.definitionFit: Naive untrained painters are called by this name, which also means earliest or original.

clue.text: Easily done — it was made on the first morning

definitions.meaning: a task that is easily done needs little effort and is not heavy

definitions.text: it was made on the first morning
definitions.meaning: in Genesis, God says 'Let there be' this on the first day of creation

explanation.definitionFit: Undemanding work is not heavy; and the first thing created in Genesis is daylight.

clue.text: Government order backing plea to arrest me

indicators.note: backing means the pieces that follow are read from the end to the start

parts.note: O is the cry of entreaty, as in 'O, spare me!'
to arrest someone is to grab them

explanation.surface: A government decree is supported by someone begging not to be detained.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' turns O + GRAB + ME into OGRABME read from the end, giving the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: An official ban on trade with another country is a decree issued by a government.

clue.text: Feeling uncertainly with hand and leg, being in drink

indicators.note: being in tells us the leg word is placed inside the drink word

parts.note: grog is rum and water, a sailor's drink
pin is slang for leg, as in 'unsteady on your pins'

explanation.surface: A tipsy person fumbles about, limbs going everywhere after too much drink.
explanation.definitionFit: To grope is to search blindly by touch, fumbling with your fingers.

clue.text: Abandon the fight

definitions.meaning: to give up on a plan or discard something as useless

explanation.definitionFit: To ditch a plan is to drop it, and a brawl is informally a punch-up.

clue.text: Mill, for example, produces this weekly

definitions.meaning: John Stuart Mill wrote on political economy
a periodical published each week, here the British news magazine of that name

explanation.walkthrough: 'Mill' looks like a factory turning out a product, but it is the philosopher John Stuart Mill.
explanation.definitionFit: Mill was a theorist of political economy; the London news magazine of the same name comes out every week.

clue.text: For example, a daughter started in profession

parts.note: 'a' is an example of the indefinite article in grammar

explanation.surface: Someone says a daughter has begun her career.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a' is not a link here: the word itself is an example of a grammatical article.
explanation.definitionFit: A trainee bound by articles of apprenticeship, such as a solicitor's clerk, has begun in a profession.

clue.text: He may treat people by reconstructing their past

indicators.note: reconstructing suggests rebuilding the letters into a fresh order

explanation.surface: A counsellor helps people by going back over their earlier lives.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reconstructing' rearranges THEIRPAST; the surface also fits a counsellor exploring clients' histories.
explanation.definitionFit: A counsellor or psychotherapist treats people for mental or physical problems.

clue.text: Talk of path where pass should be?

definitions.text: Talk of path where pass should be?

parts.words: Talk of path where pass should be?
parts.note: a speaker who says 'path' when meaning 'pass' turns the S sound into TH, a speech impediment

explanation.definitionFit: This speech defect turns sibilant S sounds into TH sounds, so pass comes out as path.

clue.text: Horror film is about son getting mental illness

indicators.note: about signals the film and 'is' together go round the son abbreviation

parts.note: Psycho is Hitchcock's horror film of 1960

explanation.surface: A horror movie about a boy depicts madness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' wraps the film and 'is' together round the S, so the son letter sits at the join between them.
explanation.definitionFit: A severe mental disorder in which contact with reality is lost.

clue.text: On side boundaries keeping West Indies on top of English

indicators.note: in a down clue, on top of means placed above the next piece
keeping signals the boundary word holds the West Indies inside it

parts.note: edges are boundaries

explanation.surface: A cricket report has the West Indies beating England by hitting boundaries.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, a boundary is a shot reaching the edge of the field; here 'boundaries' simply means edges.
explanation.definitionFit: Edge-on means sideways, with the side foremost.

clue.text: Nice money received by agricultural worker

indicators.note: received by signals the money letter goes inside the worker word

parts.note: a peasant is a farm labourer
L is the abbreviation for pound, from Latin libra

explanation.surface: Someone describes a farmhand receiving a handsome sum of cash.
explanation.walkthrough: 'received by' puts L inside PEASANT after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Something agreeable or enjoyable is nice.

clue.text: Boy in depression

definitions.meaning: a boy's name, short for ... or similar
a narrow valley, especially in Scotland

explanation.definitionFit: It is a man's name, and a Scottish word for a narrow valley, a hollow in the land.

clue.text: True lady involved in this? Hardly!

definitions.text: True lady involved in this? Hardly!

indicators.note: involved suggests the letters are tangled up together into a new order

explanation.surface: A truly virtuous woman would hardly be caught up in an affair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'involved' rearranges TRUELADY; the whole clue also defines: a faithful wife would hardly take part.
explanation.definitionFit: Infidelity in marriage is something a faithful woman would hardly be involved in.

clue.text: Request ace and beat it!

parts.note: to beg is to request
an ace is the one in a pack of cards

explanation.surface: A player asks for a top card and is told to clear off.
explanation.definitionFit: An old-fashioned command to go away, like telling someone to get lost.

clue.text: Service provided for rock group

parts.note: Mass is a church service
if means provided that

explanation.surface: A church service is held for a band playing rock music.
explanation.definitionFit: A compact group of mountains, a block of rock, forms a mountain mass.

clue.text: Draw another of trainer's horses, not a starter for bookies

indicators.note: not tells us a letter is to be dropped from the horse word

parts.note: a horse from the same racing yard is a stablemate

indicators.note: a starter for means the opening letter of the next word

explanation.surface: A racing tipster picks another horse from the same yard, but bookmakers are not interested.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not' removes B, the first letter of 'bookies', from STABLEMATE.
explanation.definitionFit: In chess, a position where no legal move is possible ends in a draw.

clue.text: Start to penetrate into earth — throw this up?

indicators.note: into signals the letter goes inside the earth word

parts.note: soil is earth

indicators.note: start to means the first letter of the following word

explanation.surface: A digger begins to push into the ground and wonders what will be thrown up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'into' puts P, the first letter of 'penetrate', inside SOIL.
explanation.definitionFit: Earth thrown up from digging is waste material heaped beside the excavation.

clue.text: Admitting the sea needs a clean

parts.note: to wash is to clean

explanation.surface: A deck taking in seawater needs a scrub.
explanation.definitionFit: A deck awash is flooded, letting the sea in over it.

clue.text: Put bad ideas here?

indicators.note: bad suggests the letters are spoiled and rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone suggests where to set aside poor notions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bad' rearranges IDEAS; the whole clue also defines, since unwanted ideas are put to one side.
explanation.definitionFit: To put something to one side is to set it apart and disregard it.

clue.text: Fateful order one has reason to follow

indicators.note: to follow places the reason word after the other pieces

parts.note: OM is the Order of Merit, a British honour
I is the Roman numeral for one
nous is common sense or intelligence

explanation.surface: A fatal command is given to one who has good reason to obey it.
explanation.definitionFit: Something portentous threatens doom, as a fateful event foreshadows disaster.

clue.text: Print style for listing characters

definitions.meaning: a typeface style used for emphasis
letters that lean or slope, as a ship lists to one side

explanation.definitionFit: Sloping type is a printing style, and its letters lean over like a listing ship.

clue.text: Stream of consciousness? Not when one comes out of it

definitions.text: Stream of consciousness? Not when one comes out of it

parts.words: Stream of consciousness? Not when one comes out of it
parts.note: in Greek myth the dead drink from a river of the underworld and forget everything, so emerging from it brings no awareness

explanation.definitionFit: The underworld river of Greek myth makes those who drink from it forget their past lives.

clue.text: Speed with battle force to presumed lair of monster

parts.note: a fleet is a force of warships
Loch Ness in Scotland is the supposed home of the Loch Ness Monster

explanation.surface: A navy sets off fast for the home of a Scottish monster.
explanation.walkthrough: Loch Ness is a Scottish lake supposedly home to a monster nicknamed Nessie.
explanation.definitionFit: Being fleet means being swift, so the noun means swiftness.
